allowedWork: One fraction split/merge reader-transition migration to the canonical equation session.
Canonical semantic construction and governed-draft schemas, compilers, validation, repair, and deterministic projection.
Isolated review fixtures for existing fraction, exponent, radical, and compound traces.
A browser-native review gallery inside the existing review or Workbench architecture.
Consolidation of proven duplicate low-level safety utilities when behavior and consumers are covered in the same slice.
Exact project-memory, plan-authority, Theseus, and closeout updates required for the approved direction.
disallowedWork: No second renderer, material layer, animation runtime, clock, or authoring artifact.
No fraction, glyph, character, KaTeX-class, viewport, route, or operation-specific runtime corrections.
No model-authored LaTeX truth, DOM, HTML fragments, selectors, geometry, coordinates, paths, keyframes, timing tables, styles, fonts, renderer modes, accessibility markup, or export code.
No migration of a second product reader family or global equation-family or editor-surface rollout.
No quadratic redesign, derivative or FTC work, arithmetic quantity models, cross-domain exemplars, publication-platform work, or unrelated UI work.
No broad utils extraction without identical authority, lifetime, error, and security contracts.
goal: Prove one canonical semantic-to-renderer construction path, migrate one fraction split/merge reader transition exclusively, and establish governed model variation plus browser-native review without parallel runtimes.
commitCadence: Commit every independently reversible verified slice with exact path staging and its completed Theseus evidence.
stopConditions: Stop if the predecessor release contract is not closed cleanly or plan authority cannot select this target without competing active implementation work.
Stop if the fraction migration needs notation, character, route, viewport, KaTeX-class, or operation-specific renderer logic.
Stop if any migrated frame has both compatibility and canonical paint or lineage-backed split or merge material uses opacity fading.
Stop if native endpoint typography, mathematics, accessibility, interaction, or semantic DOM must be mutated.
Stop if DOM, HTML, glyphs, geometry, timing, CSS, fonts, renderer state, or unverified mathematics enters a durable or provider-authored schema.
Stop if another product reader family must be migrated to prove the contract.
Stop if a new paint kind, lifecycle, renderer mode, semantic taxonomy, scheduler, runtime, material layer, or clock is required.
Stop if direct seek, rewind, reduced motion, responsive composition, static, headless, export, or production closure fails without one bounded generic repair.
Stop if ordinary route or payload ceilings regress and cannot be recovered through in-scope deletion.
Stop if visual inspection finds snap, wrong scale, double ink, clipping, unexplained line travel, unreadable overlap, or misleading pedagogy.
Stop if consolidation would merge helpers with different authority, lifetime, failure, or security contracts.

Continue after slice 15 only because the user explicitly waived that pause, and only if every named fraction acceptance criterion, browser assertion, contact-sheet inspection, and release budget passes.
Stop if work touches deferred domains, unrelated user drafts, or cannot preserve unrelated dirty-worktree changes.
Stop if the context cannot safely complete the remaining contract and record an exact handoff.
